heuristic_types.tool_count: Count of extruder tools (tool_count_1, tool_count_2, tool_count_4)
heuristic_types.cpu_arch_match: Match against host CPU architecture string

printers.name: Creality K2 Plus

options.description_key: Monitor for print abnormalities (K2 Plus camera-based)

printers._print_start_default_phases_comment: Measured on a K2 Plus 2026-08-18 (three captured prints): three homing rail rounds ~15s; nozzle wipe plus both BOX_NOZZLE_CLEAN passes ~60s; the bed-mesh toggle is optional (emit_when_disabled: false) and its check-passed validation runs ~6s - a failed check re-meshes (67-pt adaptive) and the prediction history learns that after the first such print. Heating is omitted - the thermal model owns those.

printers.name: Creality K1C
printers._print_start_default_phases_comment: Measured on a K1C 2026-08-19 (flowrate print, full prep chain): homing via CX_ROUGH_G28 ran 60s vs the 30s generic default; the nozzle wipe (CLEAR_NOZZLE_QUICK rounds) ran ~85s; a check-passed mesh (4-corner validation + 25-point sweep at 5.5s/point) ran 123s. Heating phases are omitted - the thermal model owns those.

printers.name: Qidi Max 4
printers.notes: Linux framebuffer display. Detection + preset are community-tested on-device; the QIDI Box is detected/read via the qidi_box backend, but Max 4 box CONTROL diverges from the Q2/Plus 4 -- eject/unload uses the multi_color_controller dialect (MULTI_COLOR_BOX_UNLOAD SLOT=slotN), not the shared box_stepper FORCE_MOVE primitive (rejected as 'Invalid pin value'). Per-model box dispatch tracked in prestonbrown/helixscreen#1083.

printers.name: Sovol SV06 ACE

display.notes: 4.3" Goodix capacitive touchscreen at 480x272. The Goodix controller may report an 800x480 ABS range; the calibration wizard runs on first boot when that mismatch is detected (#123).

printers.note: Distinct SKU from the plain Sovol SV06 but shares the i3 Cartesian platform and 220x220x250 build volume. The load-cell fingerprint is smart_effector + hx711 + lis2dw: mainline 'smart_effector' is the reliable signal, while 'hx711' is a Sovol fork extra whose object-list enumeration is unconfirmed. ACE vs Plus-ACE is distinguished only by build volume (<=240 vs >=280). Hosts without an 'ace' token may still resolve to 'Sovol SV06' if the load-cell objects are absent.
